=== SHEET: Temporary Regime notification  ===
Temporary regime notification for small ESG rating providers

Item | Requirement | Response | Unique reference number of document submitted | Title of document submitted
Balance sheet and net turnover (Article 3(2)(a) and (b) and Article 5(2)(a) and (b) of Directive 2013/34/EU)
1 | Last audited financial statement demonstrating balance sheet total and net turnover* | [Please specify balance sheet total and net turnover in EUR]
Number of employees (Article 3(2)(c) and Article 3(5)(c) of Directive 2013/34/EU)
2 | Employment records for last financial year | [Please specify average number of employees during the financial year]
* In the case of a newly established legal entity, projected figures such as founding accounts, business projections and “bona fide” estimates accompanied by managerial sign-off can be submitted instead.
